title: Beetroot Juice and Exercise for Clinical Health and Athletic Performance: A Narrative Review
authors: Eunjoo Lee, Hun-Young Park, Yerin Sun, Jae-Ho Choi, Seungyeon Woo, Sohyang Cho, Suyoung Kim, Yuannin...
abstract: This review examines beetroot juice's physiological effects on health and athletic performance. Beetroot juice primarily benefits endurance exercise by improving oxygen efficiency, with variable impacts on other health and performance metrics.

title: Role of Redox Signaling and Inflammation in Skeletal Muscle Adaptations to Training
authors: Maria Carmen Gomez-Cabrera, Jose Viña, Li Li Ji
abstract: This review examines how inflammation and redox signaling influence skeletal muscle protein metabolism and adaptations to exercise. It highlights that anti-inflammatory drugs can modulate exercise-induced protein synthesis, and that antioxidants and anti-inflammatories have complex effects on athletic performance.

title: Beetroot juice supplementation and exercise performance: is there more to the story than just nitrate?
authors: William S. Zoughaib, Madison J. Fry, Ahaan Singhal, Andrew R. Coggan
abstract: This review compared beetroot juice and nitrate salts for exercise performance. Beetroot juice may offer additional benefits beyond nitrate, possibly due to other compounds, but more research is needed.

title: Vitamin Supplementation in Sports: A Decade of Evidence-Based Insights
authors: Magdalena Wiacek, Emilia Nowak, Piotr Lipka, Remigiusz Denda, Igor Z. Zubrzycki
abstract: This review synthesizes a decade of research on vitamin supplementation in athletes. Vitamin D deficiency is common, and while some vitamins aid performance, supplementation should be individualized and based on confirmed deficiencies.

title: Effects of Beetroot Juice Supplementation on Cardiorespiratory Endurance in Athletes. A Systematic Review
authors: Raúl Domínguez, Eduardo Cuenca, José Luis Maté-Muñoz, Pablo García-Fernández, Noemí Serra-Paya, Marí...
abstract: This systematic review analyzed studies on beetroot juice supplementation and cardiorespiratory endurance in athletes. Beetroot juice supplementation appears to improve cardiorespiratory endurance by increasing efficiency, though combined supplementation effects are unclear.

title: Effects of beetroot juice supplementation on intermittent high-intensity exercise efforts
authors: Raúl Domínguez, José Luis Maté-Muñoz, Eduardo Cuenca, Pablo García-Fernández, Fernando Mata-Ordoñez,...
abstract: This paper reviews studies on beetroot juice supplementation and high-intensity exercise. Beetroot juice may improve performance in intermittent high-intensity efforts by aiding phosphocreatine resynthesis and muscle power.

title: Possible Effects of Beetroot Supplementation on Physical Performance Through Metabolic, Neuroendocrine, and Antioxidant Mechanisms: A Narrative Review of the Literature
abstract: This review examines how beetroot supplementation might enhance physical performance. Findings suggest beetroot's nitrate content, leading to increased nitric oxide, is key to improved muscle function and nutrient delivery.

title: Effects of Beetroot Juice on Physical Performance in Professional Athletes and Healthy Individuals: An Umbrella Review
authors: Chen Tian, Qingrui Jiang, Mengke Han, Lu Guo, Ruixin Huang, Li Zhao, Shanshan Mao
abstract: This umbrella review examined beetroot juice's effects on physical performance. Beetroot juice showed negligible improvements in muscle strength and aerobic endurance, with small benefits for lactate tolerance.

title: Physiological Effects of Beetroot in Athletes and Patients
authors: Hanna Olsson, Jonathan Al-Saadi, Daniel Oehler, Joseph Pergolizzi, Peter Magnusson
abstract: This review examined beetroot juice's effects on athletic training and performance. Beetroot juice can improve exercise efficiency and may benefit patients with certain chronic diseases, though more research is needed.

title: Dietary Beetroot Juice – Effects in Patients with COPD: A Review
authors: Mingming Chen, Shuting Chang, Yunpeng Xu, Hong Guo, Jian Liu
abstract: This review examines beetroot juice's potential benefits for COPD patients. Beetroot juice may improve exercise capacity, blood pressure, vascular function, and sleep quality in COPD.

title: Beetroot Juice Supplementation as a Healthy Aging Strategy Through Improving Physical Performance and Cognitive Functions: A Systematic Review
authors: Anna Nowak, Angelika Szymańska, Magdalena Kwaśniewska, Ewa Kochan, Anna Lipert
abstract: This systematic review examined beetroot juice supplementation's effects on physical performance and cognitive function. Beetroot shows strong potential for enhancing physical performance, but its cognitive benefits are inconclusive.
